description: This project is located and Bandelier National Monument, New Mexico. Reconstruct and or replace all utility distribution and collection systems to address deferred maintenance and code deficiencies on 60 plus year old systems. Utilities included are underground potable water lateral service lines and the distribution mains for required fire flow and storage; electrical and natural gas distribution to meet current and projected demand; and replace communication systems infrastructure. Primary electrical will be replaced to areas not addressed by the 2017 primary electrical service project (which went to Frijoles Canyon development only). Rehabilitate existing sewer collection mains and replace all secondary sewer lateral lines to include manholes.
